name: Lower Manhattan
text: Lower Manhattan, also known as Downtown Manhattan, is the southernmost part of the New York City borough of Manhattan. The area is the historical birthplace of New York City and in the 17th and 18th centuries composed the entirety of the city. Lower Manhattan serves as the seat of government of both Manhattan and the entire City of New York.

credit.text: Eden, Janine and Jim from New York City

depictions.name: Lower Manhattan
depictions.text: Lower Manhattan is the main location of the Warlords of New York expansion. The area consists of 4 PvE zones and one Settlement.
